jobs.title: Executive Security Liaison & VIP Protection Lead
jobs.description:
Prosegur Security USA, Inc in Irving, TX is seeking an experienced executive protection professional to oversee entry control to the executive suite, respond to threats, and manage crisis situations. You will deliver concierge-level service to visitors and build strong, trusted relationships with corporate teams and partners.

This role requires 5–10 years in executive protection or law enforcement, 5+ years in customer service, and proven incident management skills.
